top_signals.title: Bybit adds Unitree, Moonshot AI to pre-IPO perpetuals lineup
top_signals.summary: The additions come as Bybit’s TradFi perpetuals lineup grows to more than 200 products spanning equities, ETFs, commodities, indices and private companies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: France investigates tax authority breach after hacker claims 600,000 victims
top_signals.summary: French authorities confirmed that someone gained unauthorized access to systems at the Directorate General of Public Finances in late June after stealing or misusing someone’s identity.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
